Gage, saw GoFreight rolling out smart quotations and rate management as it crosses a thousand forwarders on the platform.

I built a personalized signal play for GoFreight off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings GoFreight needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
